title: Time bound for marker stripping
statement: For every Boolean word $x$, the raw marker-stripping machine computes the function that returns the prefix strictly before the last true bit of $x$, or the empty word if no true bit occurs, in time $4(|x|+1)$. That is, it halts after this many steps with that output, using some amount of work-tape space.
replaced:
For every $n$ and every input $x$ of length $n$, the marker-stripping
machine halts within $4(n+1)$ steps, and its output is the prefix of $x$
strictly before its last $1$ bit, or the empty word when $x$ contains no
$1$.
